title: Russian Pilaf with Manchego Cheese
description: A hearty and flavorful pilaf dish from Russia, topped with melted Manchego cheese. This comforting meal is perfect for a cold evening.

ingredients.name: Manchego Cheese
ingredients.notes: sharp cheese, can be substituted with Cheddar

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped yellow onion and cook until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped red bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the pilaf and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes.
Add the heavy cream and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook, covered, until the liquid has been absorbed and the pilaf is tender, about 15-20 minutes.
Stir in the shredded Manchego cheese until melted and well combined.
Season the pilaf with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
